Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! Pakistan move ahead but West Indies have a chance to level it up as they meet Pakistan on Friday, 10th June for the 2nd ODI at 4.30 pm (11 am GMT). Kindly join us early for the coverage. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Babar Azam, the skipper of Pakistan says he tries to work on his game and on his strengths. The partnership between him and Rizwan was much needed. The wicket was two-paced and even West Indies bowled really well. Shares that they prepared well for the conditions and he credits the bowlers, especially Shadab Khan who is coming after a long halt and has been excellent on the field. Tells that cricket needs to be played with tactics and high intensity and it is going along the plan for them. Informs they need to take the game deep so that there is less pressure on the finishers.

Babar Azam wins the Player of the Match award but he hands it to Khushdil Shah for his match-winning performance. Shah says the situation was to take the game till the end and give his best. Adds that he is been working hard for a couple of years on his game and the management has helped him a lot to better his game. Shares that he tried to hit the ball which was in his zones.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies say that it is not good to lose this way as they batted well and got a good target above 300. Mentions that Pakistan is world class team and especially their skipper, Babar Azam. Further says that he's really proud of the guys and they played really well. Applauds Shai Hope and says he played really well in tough conditions and all the credit to him.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, Windies, courtesy of Hope's ton got to a really good total. They could have gotten a few more but Pakistan did well to pull things back in the end. That though did not prove to be enough as a combined batting effort from the hosts saw this being chased down.

West Indies bowled well with the new ball! They managed to keep the Pakistan batters quiet. However, the likes of Akeal Hosein and Hayden Walsh were disappointed. They leaked far too many runs in the middle overs. Alzarri Joseph did really well to get his side back in the game but Romario Shepherd was disappointing towards the end.

This though was a very calculated chase from Pakistan! They lost Fakhar Zaman early but Imam-ul-Haq and Babar Azam steadied things. It was slow going at the start but they eventually caught pace. Just as the game though was turning completely into Pakistan's side, Imam fell. Mohammad Rizwan though kept the good work going along with his skipper. The partnership these two added strengthened the hosts' hold on the game. However, after Azam fell, Rizwan too followed soon and it did seem like it was getting tight. Khushdil Shah though played an outstanding cameo to take his side over the line.

What a knock! What a knock that was from Khushdil Shah! He is playing as the finisher for Pakistan and has indeed justified his selection in the side. The stage was set for him to deliver and he has. Has to be said, he is one of the big reasons why Pakistan have taken a 1-0 lead in this series.

SIX! Pakistan take the lead in the series as Nawaz hits the winning runs! Short of a length and on off. Slight width and Nawaz pulls it all the way over long on for a biggie. Pakistan win by 5 wickets.
Dot ball! Short of a length on middle. Nawaz looks to pull but he was cramped for room there.
6 runs needed from the last over. Can Jayden Seales defend it?

SIX! POWERED! Short in length and on off. Khushdil Shah muscles it over deep mid-wicket for a huge six. Pakistan are one hit away now.

Who will walk out now? Mohammad Nawaz is the new batter in.

A good short one, hurries the batter. Imam looks to pull, it hits the splice and lobs on the leg side for one.
That is a really good stop! Saves two! On the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg. The fielder there dives to his right and makes a half stop. Two taken.
On the pads, it is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Bangs a bouncer now, around middle. Imam-ul-Haq sits under it.
On a length and on middle. Imam-Ul-Haq blocks it.
A length ball, outside off. Azam works it through point for a single.
Who will walk out now? Babar Azam is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! West Indies open the wickets column! Good bumper from Seales, around off. Fakhar Zaman tries to hammer it on the off side but mistimes it completely. The ball lobs nicely for Shamarh Brooks at covers who takes the simplest of catches. Good start so far from West Indies!
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Jayden Seales

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off. Imam-ul-Haq guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller delivery on off stump. Worked it to mid off.
Length ball on leg stump. Fakhar Zaman works it towards midwicket and a misfield allows the batsman to come back for two.
Straighter delivery on good length. Hits the batsman on the gloves as he works it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Well place by Imam! Short and and slighty wide. Imam beautifully gets under the delivery and plays it past backward point for a boundary!
Back of length delivery aimed at the body. Imam-ul-Haq ducks under it and lets it go to the keeper.
Good length on middle stump. Defended by Imam.
On a length and slightly slower, this is flicked towards square leg for one.
On middle, kept out.
Angled into the pads, this is pushed towards mid on for one more.
On off, kept out.
Outside off, left alone.
On off, this is pushed on the off side for one.
A dot to end! That held in the surface! Slower one outside off, Zaman is early in the push. Gets beaten.
On off, kept out.
Nicely played! Just for a single! Allows the ball to come to him and then guides it down to third man for one.
Soft leading edge! On the body, Imam looks to nudge it on the leg side, closes the face of the bat early, it goes off a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
A slower one, could be good on this wicket. Imam spots it and gently pushes it to covers.
On off, kept out.

That is a brilliant stop! Exactly what a bowler needs from his fielders! Hence, it turns out to be an excellent over. Shorter and outside off, this is slapped towards point. The fielder dives to his left and saves a boundary.
On off, this is guided to point.
Really good from Jayden Seales! Giving nothing away. On off, Zaman pushes it to covers.
On off, Zaman hangs back and pushes it to covers.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, Zaman stands tall and slaps it to covers.
A dot to end! 5 from the second over. On off, kept out.

FOUR! Like his partner, Imam too gets underway with a boundary! Not a bad delivery by Romario Shepherd. The idea was not wrong but it was not that high. Short and on middle, chest height. This is pulled over square leg and this one races away to the fence.
Goes back to bowling it on a length, kept out well.
WIDE! Not the right line, this one is down the leg side, swings away further. Left alone. Wided.
And again, looks to bring it back in from just around off. Probably hoping Imam would fall over with his front leg. Imam though does not and defends it well.
Really good line and length to begin with by Romario Shepherd! A little bit of swing too! Length and on off, comes back in a touch. Imam plays it right under his eyes and onto the ground.
Good start from Romario Shepherd! Right on the money! Solid from Imam too! On a length and on off, Imam lunges and defends.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Romario Shepherd.
Outside off, Zaman lets it go for the keeper. A good first over for Pakistan comes to an end.

FOUR! Just over the fielder! As they say, slash hard when you do so and that is what Zaman did! Short and outside off, Zaman goes after it, this flies off the outside edge over the widish slip fielder for a boundary.

FOUR! Glorious! Beautiful stroke to get off the mark. A shot which will give the batter a lot of confidence. Yes, it is a half volley but still has to be put away. Outside off, fuller, Zaman does not look to hit it hard, he leans into the delivery and strokes it through covers for a boundary.
Well left! This is closer to the off pole. Not close enough though to make the batter play. Left alone again.
Slashes but misses! Not quite the length to play this shot. Good length and outside off, angling away. Zaman goes after it but is beaten.
Solid! Better from Seales! On a length and around middle, this is kept out nicely.
Pakistan are underway courtesy an extra! Jayden Seales starts with one well wide outside off. Left alone.
